limits: Synthetic development tasks and single runs, not a published frontier benchmark.
Six incumbent results reused; temporal variance uncontrolled.
Common global instructions and best-effort catalog filtering; no pristine native comparator.
Scoring files readable under one OS user: not a protected holdout or syscall audit.
Cumulative total token counts include cached input; no quota or price savings attribution.
Observed notification-based token/tool caps can overshoot; latest-context token cap is not an aggregate turn cap.
Three failed infrastructure trials and one contaminated control retained and excluded transparently.
Skill-read detector defect repaired uniformly; original task thresholds and records preserved.
